# santati_trails (Data Source)

Every trail the API key may write to, across the configured regions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "santati_trails" "all" {}

output "trail_names" {
  value = [for trail in data.santati_trails.all.trails : trail.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `trails` (Attributes List) The trails, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trails))

<a id="nestedatt--trails"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trails`

Read-Only:

- `ingest_url` (String) The URL producers POST events to.
- `name` (String) The trail's name.
- `region` (String) The region the trail lives in.
